title: Ariana Grande Leads a Starry Christmas Carol on TV
summary: It is beginning to sound a lot like Christmas on late-night TV. Pop star Ariana Grande teamed up with Robert De Niro and Ben Stiller for a surprise Christmas carol on The Tonight Show on Sunday night. The trio sang the traditional tune 'O Christmas Tree' to ring in the holiday season. Grande took the lead on vocals, and the audience applauded when she hit those high notes. Stiller gave a valiant effort on his part of the song. As for De Niro, you will have to watch the clip to see how his turn plays out. The performance celebrated the arrival of the 2026 Rockefeller Center Christmas tree this weekend. The episode aired at 11:35 p.m. ET, right after a football game, and featured rapper Lil Baby as the musical guest. The stars were on the show to promote their new movie, Focker-in-Law, which opens in theatres on November 25. It is the latest film in the popular Meet the Parents series. Grande plays Olivia Jones, who is dating Henry, the grown-up son of Greg and Pam Focker.
why_it_matters: If you love singing Christmas songs with your family, this story shows how even famous stars enjoy sharing a carol together.
